note: Recast from the original English description of Haviland 1898. The original gives it as Termes inaequalis, n. sp., the type locality Sarawak, Borneo (type number 365); it was later placed in Parrhinotermes by Holmgren. The original marks decimals with old-style superscript points (“1*4 mm” for 1.4 mm, “12 mm” for 1.2 mm, “*6 mm” for 0.6 mm, “*7 mm” for 0.7 mm); these are converted here.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head 1.4 mm long and 1.2 mm wide, subcordate, flattened, brick red (latericious); a small pore above the clypeus, with a shallow groove running from it to the apex of the clypeus. Mandibles 0.6 mm long: the broad base of the left mandible ends in a large broad lanceolate forward-pointing tooth separated from the point by a deep gap, with another small tooth at the base of the large one; the broad base of the right mandible ends abruptly, with no gap between it and the point — differing in this from P. aequalis, whose right mandible also has a gap. Pronotum 0.7 mm wide, posterior margin evenly rounded.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 4 mm. Head 1.4 mm long and 1.2 mm wide, subcordate, flattened, brick red; a small pore above the clypeus, with a shallow groove running from that pore to the apex of the clypeus. Antenna 13 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Labrum wide, nearly square, white apically, almost reaching the apex of the mandibles. Mandibles 0.6 mm long, broad at the base, the apex a narrow notched point; the broad base of the left mandible ends in a large broad lanceolate forward-pointing tooth separated from the point by a deep gap, with another small tooth at the base of the large one; the broad base of the right mandible ends abruptly, with no gap between it and the point. Postmentum narrow, narrowest at the end of the basal third, widening behind it. Pronotum 0.7 mm wide, anterior margin convex, sides sharply rounded, posterior margin evenly rounded. Metanotum as wide as the pronotum, mesonotum slightly narrower. Hind femur almost reaching the apex of the abdomen. Abdomen narrow and long. Abdominal setal appendages absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 4 mm. Head pale yellowish white. Antenna 13 segments, segment 2 long. Thorax narrow. Hind leg not reaching the apex of the abdomen. Abdomen narrowly oval. Abdominal setal appendages absent.

sections.label: Nymph
sections.text: Antenna 16 segments, segment 2 long and segment 3 short. Clypeus convex and slightly projecting.
